channel.title: The Cooking Cards blog
channel.description: Recipes, kitchen tricks and little updates from a small warm app.

item.title: Tandoori Chicken in the Air Fryer, Card by Card
item.description: The recipe that started the whole app, served the way the app serves it. Tap through the actual cards, timers and all.

item.title: Cooking Cards Is Live, and It Is Free
item.description: The interactive cookbook is out of the kitchen and on the open web. Here is what it does, what it costs (nothing), and how to put it on your phone.

item.title: What "Three Whistles" Actually Means
item.description: Indian recipes count whistles the way other recipes count minutes. Here is how to read them, and how to translate whistles for an Instant Pot.

item.title: The Tandoori Chicken That Started It All
item.description: The marinade needs thirteen ingredients. I remembered maybe eight, guessed the quantities, and somewhere between the app store and a $100 paywall, accidentally started an app.
